notes: The supplied pages are institution-wide (home page, tuition-fee table, application guide, fee-paying student info, application portal); no page is the Vehicle Engineering programme's own page, so programmePage is null. Duration 7 semesters/2 = 3.5 years and the 2450 EUR/semester fee for non-EU applicants are taken from the 2027/2028 tuition table row "Vehicle Engineering BSc 7 2450 EUR *** 1800 EUR ***". The pages do not state a teaching language for the programme itself (the tuition table's footnote mentions dual nationality and visa-free countries, not language). No dated non-EU application deadline could be quoted: the portal gives "open until 30 June 2026" for the September 2026 intake and the other pages say the next application period for the September 2027 intake opens January/December 2026, but no quote ties a deadline to non-EU/foreign-qualification applicants, so intakes are omitted.
